children.name: Intensity is strategic, not constant. Setup: none beyond 200 ms ease-out transitions. Logging: 250 ms count-up + haptic tick on confirm. Battle: leaderboard rows animate position changes 400 ms spring; presence avatars pulse 2 s loop. Danger zone: countdown colour steps gold→orange→red; ≤30 min adds a 1 s heartbeat pulse on the timer only — layout never changes. Winner: 1.2 s confetti burst + score count-up + haptic success; sports-broadcast, never slot-machine (no spinning reels, no near-miss fakery). Reduced motion: all pulses/confetti replaced by static colour + single haptic; count-ups render final values.
